lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，黑影拖在身后。
lines.en: I slide along the ground, my black trail behind me.
The maw arrives first, and the body follows.

lines.zh: 我爬上岸，水从身上流下去。
lines.en: I climb ashore, water sheeting off me.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿一排排露在外面。
lines.en: My teeth show in rows along the outside.

lines.zh: 我在水上漂着走，比陆地快。
lines.en: I travel faster on water than on land.

lines.zh: 祭坛的铃响过，我就得动。
lines.en: The altar bell rang, so I must move.
I round the rocks and head deeper.
This thing only lasts a while.
I leave a wet trail along the mud.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，试用牙齿。
lines.en: I open and close my jaws, testing the teeth.
My shadow is blacker than my body.
I crawl slowly, in no hurry.
I lie low with my jaws shut.

lines.zh: 有水滴从我身上滑下来。
lines.en: Drops of water slide off me.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人在唱歌。
lines.en: I hear someone singing far off.
With a mouth like this, my voice is ugly.

lines.zh: 我试着往岸上爬，又停下。
lines.en: I start up the bank, then stop.
I don't need to breathe, but I pant.
I rest my jaw on the shallows.
A light sweeps over, and I pull back.
There's sand in my mouth; I spit it out.
I'm waiting to be of use.
This body is borrowed.
I grind my teeth against each other.
There's a glow over by the altar.
I smell iron and salt.
The bell's echo has grown shorter again.
I've sunk halfway again.
What did you call me out for?
This mouth isn't built for smiling.
You're standing too near the water.
I can carry you across.
I bite accurately.

lines.zh: 你脚下的水映出我的牙
lines.en: The water at your feet reflects my teeth.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只能看到你的下巴。
lines.en: I look up and see only your chin.
Don't put your hand in my mouth.
I'll vanish eventually; don't worry.
You crouch, and I lift my great maw.
This counts as companion manners.
I understand what you say.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过来，怕吓着你。
lines.en: I inch closer so I don't startle you.

lines.zh: 我身上是湿的，别靠太紧。
lines.en: I'm wet inside; don't press too close.
I shut my jaws and pull back.
That hit my teeth.
The mist scatters; I clamp myself shut again.
I roll half a turn on the ground.
Water runs out of the wound.
I make a very ugly sound.
I flatten down and guard my mouth.

lines.zh: 暗影做的嘴，咬不动就散。
lines.en: A mouth of shade: if it cannot bite, it fades.
I sink a little lower.
I'm holding this in.
Is this something to bite?
I don't eat; I only want to bite.
You hold it up, and my jaws open.
The smell stings my nose.
I could swallow it in one go.
It isn't food, but it's fine.
Hand it over; don't tease.
Once I bite, I won't let go.

lines.zh: 牙间有东西的感觉很好。
lines.en: Something between my teeth feels good.
Another one; I'm not full.
You bumped into my mouth.
I turn and give you half the path.
I'm wet; don't rub against your clothes.
My jaws touched you.
We collided by the rocks.
That was an accident.
Did my teeth graze you?
Step back; I'm turning around.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被我们扬起，看不清了。
lines.en: We've stirred the sand up; I can't see.
I'm not counting that bump.
I was only made.

lines.zh: 同类很少，我几乎见不到。
lines.en: My kind are few; I rarely see one.
The two of us circle the pool.
I won't leave any offspring.
This thing has no such thoughts.
She was summoned too.
We only lie side by side.
We block the wind together and wait.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在水里合成一个。
lines.en: Our shadows merge on the water.
When time runs out, we each go back.
I bite down and drag it into the water.

lines.zh: 我叼着它游过整片浅滩。
lines.en: I carry it across the shallows.
It's still rattling in my mouth.
I hold it up, floating.
It's wet, but not ruined.
It's heavier than it looks.
I set it down on the bank.
A bit of skin is caught on my teeth.
I swallow, and it doesn't go down.
Take it; I'll let go first.
There's something moving ahead.
I open my jaws and try first.
My teeth grew for this.
It's in the water — perfect.
I come up from downstream.
I've locked on; don't let go.
It's much smaller than I am.
I crawl directly beneath it.
Once I bite, nothing else matters.
Stand clear a little.
I open my mouth and wait for it to come closer.
This bite is for my master.
The shadow bell rings, and I come.
I lie on the mud with only my eyes showing.
It isn't watching below.
My teeth show white in the dark.
I sink another half foot.
It turns, and I freeze.
My shadow on the surface gives me away.
I change approach, from the flank.
I hear it splashing.
Its leg is right at my mouth.
This bite must go deep.
I open as wide as I can.
Almost — it's right at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，合得很紧。
lines.en: I bite down and hold tight.
I shake my head and drag it into the water.

lines.zh: 牙齿互相咬合的声音很响。
lines.en: The sound of my teeth meeting is loud.
My jaws close around it entirely.
I press it down into the mud.
That bite caught nothing.
I open again.
It's struggling hard.
Blood mixes into the water.
I pull back and pant once.
The Shadow Bell rang.

lines.zh: 我从祭坛的黑雾里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the black mist on the altar.
This great mouth appears first.
I'm wet; I came from the water.
I've been borrowed for a while.
A patch of water is left on the floor.
I raise my head to you and wait for orders.
My teeth click once.
This body isn't steady.
I can walk, and I can carry.
The air around us has gone cold.
I crawl slowly toward you.
The clock has started.
A bubble swells on the water's surface first.

lines.zh: 火烤在我湿皮上，冒起白烟。
lines.en: Fire hits my wet hide and white steam rises.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔进浅水，牙磕了一下。
lines.en: I fall off the bank into the shallows and my teeth jar.

lines.zh: 水灌满我的嘴，我喘不上来。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I can't draw breath.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，黑雾散开。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my mist scatters.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的嘴侧，扎得很深。
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my jaw.

lines.zh: 那股光把我压在水面上。
lines.en: That light pins me to the water's surface.

lines.zh: 太久没咬东西，我的牙发软。
lines.en: Too long without biting, and my teeth feel soft.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我全身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 没有水，也没有地，我在往下掉。
lines.en: No water, no ground; I keep falling.
